title: Why Did Jesus Come to Earth?
speaker: Antwan Cronje
summary:
Most people think the cross begins on Good Friday. It begins in a garden. In the Apostles' Creed series, Pastor Antwan runs the whole storyline and helps us to answer the question: “Why did Jesus come to earth?”

Notes: Read the sermon notes
quotes: We didn't lose a garden. We lost the face of God.
He paid a debt he didn't owe because we owed a debt we couldn't pay.
He died to get you hope. He died to get you home.
